events.title: Midsummer Nights Scream Showcase
events.summary: Hello everyone,I’m excited to share some great news!Inherited Shadows will be featured in its first major gaming showcase: the Horror Game Awards 2026 Midsummer Nights Scream Showcase, taking place on June 1st.For those who are new to the project, Inherited Shadows is a first-person survival horror game that follows Amanda as she investigates the dark secrets surrounding her mother's past. events.title: FRENCH LOCALIZATION
events.summary: Dear followers,I'm excited to share that French localization is now in progress for Inherited Shadows. A talented translator is currently working on bringing the game to our French-speaking community, helping deliver a more immersive and authentic experience.This is an important step for the future of the game, and I truly appreciate your continued support.Merci à tous !
